answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with a delta-graded trust trellis. New identities start at the lowest rung and gain a small delta of standing per epoch, no matter how many accounts they spawn, so flooding the network buys no speed. Each claimed task must be mirrored: an independent counterpart with no shared history reproduces the result before credit is granted. Endorsements must braid across at least three separate trellis branches, preventing a single operator's cluster from vouching for itself. Exact mirror duplicates void both claims and freeze the lineage for one window.
